title: Baseline QEM Mesh Simplifier - Repo Recon & Integration Plan
acceptance: A single deliverable (or clearly linked artifact set) provides sections A-F in order: Repo Recon, Proposed Architecture, Public API Design, Baseline QEM Algorithm Plan, Implementation Checklist, and Build/Integration Notes.

Repo recon is grounded in actual repository inspection and explicitly identifies inferred build system, top-level layout, rendering/GUI organization, mesh-related code locations, and math libraries; unknowns are called out with 1-2 reasonable options.
Proposed QEM module architecture is removable/system-agnostic, separates core/adapters/io/viewer layers, and keeps the core library free of viewer/GUI/render backend dependencies.
Public API defines SimplifyOptions, SimplifyResult, and a Simplify entry point with concise header-level examples showing how glint can call through a thin adapter boundary.

Baseline QEM algorithm plan specifies face planes, quadric accumulation, edge enumeration, deterministic priority queue behavior, collapse validation, local updates, and optimal-position solve fallback policy for singular systems.

Implementation checklist includes staged milestones and non-rendering unit tests with known meshes and invariants, plus minimal-churn build integration notes based on the repository build system actually present.
Data ownership/lifetime rules, epsilon policy, stable tie-breaks, and deterministic indexing expectations are documented explicitly.
